items.text: **Пока** is used as an adverb of time and as a conjunction. **Пока не** (until) is a conjunction. A. The adverb of time — **пока** — means:
points: *Никому не говорите об этом пока!* — for the time being;
*Сведений о самолёте пока (ещё) нет.* — as yet;
*Я посижу здесь, а ты пока сбегай в лавку.* — in the meantime.

blocks.text: B. The conjunction **ПОКА** — while — introduces adverbial clauses of time.

The action of both the main and the subordinate clauses can: a) completely coincide in time (imperfective verbs are used in both): *Пока шёл дождь, мы стояли под деревом.* b) partly coincide in time (perfective aspect is used in one of the clauses or in both): *Пока она готовила обед, я написал 2 письма.*
C. The construction **ПОКА НЕ** (until, before) is used as a unit to introduce subordinate adverbial clauses of time.

**ПОКА НЕ** has no negative meaning and the particle **НЕ** is not translated: *Он читал, пока не устали глаза. Я посижу здесь, пока вы не придёте.* Sometimes a compound conjunction — **ДО ТЕХ ПОР ПОКА НЕ** — is used instead: *Ученик повторял адрес до тех пор, пока не выучил его наизусть.*
From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 105.

exercises.q: Том пережидал дождь под деревом, ___ (while) тот не прекратился.
exercises.prompt: Tom waited under the tree until it stopped raining.
exercises.why: **пока** — «while»: opens a clause about something happening at the same time.

exercises.prompt: Stir the soup until it boils.
exercises.why: **пока** — «while»: opens a clause about something happening at the same time.

exercises.q: Я не буду спать, Гортензио, ___ (until) увижу её.
exercises.prompt: I will not sleep, Hortensio, till I see her.
exercises.why: **пока не** — «until»: пока не is one unit that opens a time clause; the не is not translated.

exercises.prompt: Don't count your chickens before they are hatched.
exercises.why: **пока не** — «until»: пока не is one unit that opens a time clause; the не is not translated.
**пока** — «while»: opens a clause about something happening at the same time.

exercises.q: Я был спокойным до тех пор, ___ (until) увидел шприц!
exercises.prompt: I was calm until I saw the syringe!
exercises.why: **пока не** — «until»: пока не is one unit that opens a time clause; the не is not translated.
